card.name: Verb before "the same" in strength comparisons
card.fires_on: The word "is" or "are" right before "the same" when strength or ingredient is compared across products. Also the word "curve" or "area" in exposure comparisons based on AUC or body surface area.

modes.label: Same strength clause
modes.description: A linking verb after strength or ingredient, just before "the same" in a not-interchangeable warning.
modes.example: Bupivacaine liposome injectable suspension is not substitutable with other bupivacaine products even if the strength<< is>> the same.

modes.label: Exposure comparison basis
modes.description: The end of "area under the curve" or "body surface area" in animal-to-human exposure comparisons.
